courses.note: The major requires no operating systems or security course; the degree plan requires CSE 351 Parallelism & Concurrency (upper-level systems) and ECEN 106 Computer Systems (lower level). No syllabus page was found. The public repository byui-cse/cse351-student-version (pushed Oct 2026) holds only lesson files, none of which mentions AI, so it is not treated as a syllabus.

notes: The degree plan (2025-26 and 2026-27) lists CSE 110, 111, 210, 212, 370, 381 and others. The university also expects every syllabus to carry a generative-AI statement (byui.edu/genai/ai-in-the-syllabus), but no term-dated syllabi for these courses were public; the course sites at byui-cse.github.io and pathway.cse.byui.edu are the nearest public documents.
